verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an Indian data-residency option and self-hosting on your own servers via Docker or Kubernetes for private enterprise deployments, which covers the data-residency part of the story. Nothing in the pack mentions HIPAA, a BAA, or SOC 2 attestation, so most of the compliance story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: HIPAA/BAA support, SOC 2 certification, data-residency regions beyond India, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run regulated workloads with HIPAA/BAA support, SOC 2, and data-residency options

citations.quote: Indian data residency is available for deployments where data must remain in India.
self-host Bolna Voice AI on your own servers using Docker or Kubernetes for secure, private, and scalable enterprise deployments
